importantCorrection: VALIDATING -> NEEDS_CORRECTION is a required server-side transition so collectors can create a correction revision before supervisor review.

blockingPolicy.ERROR: blocks review and routes back to collector
blockingPolicy.ENVIRONMENTAL_ALERT: persists and proceeds to PENDING_REVIEW without data-quality penalty solely for environmental condition

validationFlags.strategy: replace flags for the current revision on each validation run

atomicity: submission patch, revision validation map, replacement validation flags, and audit event must be committed atomically by the Firestore server adapter
